g.text: Select batches; the daily batch always runs, optional backfill only in GREEN
Store batch as received with checksum (raw layer)
Validate variant, retailer, currency, positive price, time
Normalize decimal amount, UTC time, currency code
Add to reject list with reason
Upsert accepted records by stable source identity
Keep one open forecast job per laptop (deadline now + 24 h, never reset)
Record failed import run; retry at next trigger
